content.title: Defense stocks rise on Trump comments, Oklo upgraded to Buy
content.description:
Yahoo Finance Host Josh Lipton tracks today's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute, including the stock moves for defense contractors Lockheed Martin (LMT), L3Harris Technologies (LHX), and GE Aerospace (GE) after President Trump's address at the World Economic Forum (WEF), and shares of Oklo (OKLO) receiving an upgrade to Buy from Bank of America analysts.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
